description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Susith Samarawickrama Liyanage as a member of the Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local authority level, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a seat that became vacant due to a party membership change. This falls squarely under Election-related matters.
